Container.Name: Moodle
Container.Overview: Self-contained Moodle LMS 5.2 in a single container: nginx, PHP-FPM 8.3, MariaDB, Redis (sessions) and Moodle cron, managed by supervisord.[br][br] By default the image is built from the MuTMS distribution (Moodle plus multi-tenancy, programs and certifications). Which distribution is used is fixed when the image is built, not here - see the README to build plain Moodle instead.[br][br] FIRST START: set MOODLE_URL to the exact address you will use in the browser (for example http://192.168.1.50:8080). The first start installs Moodle and takes 2-10 minutes; follow progress in the container log. If you leave the admin password empty, a generated one is written to /config/secrets/admin_password in the Config path.[br][br] PLUGINS: by default, copy add-on plugins into [b]config/plugins[/b] using Moodle's folder layout (for example plugins/mod/customcert or plugins/theme/moove), then restart the container. Alternatively set [b]Web plugin install[/b] to true to install plugins from Moodle's own web interface - they are copied back into config/plugins automatically, so they survive container updates.[br][br] REVERSE PROXY: use an https:// MOODLE_URL and SSL proxy mode switches on automatically.
Container.Requires: Build and push the image first (see README), or replace Repository with your own image name.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port. Must match the port in MOODLE_URL unless a reverse proxy is used.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Add-on plugins (plugins/), generated secrets (secrets/) and optional config.extra.php.

Config.Name: Moodle data
Config.Description: Uploaded course files, caches and language packs. Can grow large.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: Bundled MariaDB data. Keep this on a cache pool / SSD.

Config.Name: Moodle URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Exact URL users type, without trailing slash or sub-path. Examples: http://192.168.1.50:8080 or https://moodle.example.com

Config.Name: Site full name
Config.Description: Used on first install only.

Config.Name: Site short name
Config.Description: Used on first install only.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Used on first install only.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Used on first install only. Leave empty to generate one (saved to /config/secrets/admin_password).

Config.Name: Admin email
Config.Description: Used on first install only.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: PHP/Moodle default timezone, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns moodledata (Unraid default 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns moodledata (Unraid default 100 = users).

Config.Name: SSL proxy
Config.Description: auto (on when MOODLE_URL is https), true or false. Needed when a reverse proxy terminates HTTPS.

Config.Name: Web plugin install
Config.Description: true lets you install plugins from Moodle's web interface. Anything you install is copied back to the Config path automatically so it survives container updates. false (default) means plugins are added by copying them into config/plugins.

Config.Name: Plugin sync interval
Config.Description: Seconds between checks for web-installed plugins. Only used when web plugin install is enabled.

Config.Name: Auto upgrade
Config.Description: Run the Moodle database upgrade automatically after an image update or plugin change.

Config.Name: DB type
Config.Description: mariadb, mysqli or pgsql. The bundled database only supports mariadb.

Config.Name: DB host
Config.Description: Keep 127.0.0.1 to use the bundled MariaDB, or enter an external database host.

Config.Name: DB port
Config.Description: Leave empty for the default (3306 / 5432).

Config.Name: DB name
Config.Description: Database name.

Config.Name: DB user
Config.Description: Database user.

Config.Name: DB password
Config.Description: Leave empty with the bundled DB to auto-generate. Required for an external DB.

Config.Name: MariaDB buffer pool
Config.Description: InnoDB buffer pool for the bundled MariaDB. Larger is faster (e.g. 1G-4G on big sites).

Config.Name: Redis sessions
Config.Description: Store sessions in Redis (bundled unless Redis host is changed).

Config.Name: Redis host
Config.Description: Keep 127.0.0.1 for the bundled Redis.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: host:port, e.g. smtp.example.com:587. Empty = configure in the Moodle admin UI.

Config.Name: SMTP security
Config.Description: Empty, tls or ssl.

Config.Name: SMTP user
Config.Description: SMTP username.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: SMTP password.

Config.Name: No-reply address
Config.Description: From address for notifications, e.g. noreply@example.com.

Config.Name: PHP memory limit
Config.Description: PHP memory_limit.

Config.Name: Max upload size
Config.Description: Maximum upload size (PHP and nginx).

Config.Name: PHP-FPM max children
Config.Description: Concurrent PHP workers. Roughly RAM available for PHP divided by 60MB.
